# fct_trips

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_trips` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Trip are a contact's travel plan, from initial inquiry to confirmed booking. Trips can contain multiple Bookings. Includes information about the Trip itself (pipeline stage, status, reason, etc.) and summaries of Bookings (such as what their supplier types are). Each row represents a single Trip. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `trip_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each Trip record. >>  SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `automation_stage` | Stage assigned by the system automation rules based on predefined logic (inquiry, planning, booking, pre-trip, traveling, traveled). May differ from the Stage which can be changed by the user or the automation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `booking_count` | The number of Bookings associated with the trip. Includes both canceled & non-canceled. >>  SOURCE - Portal |
